pass_standard: REAL production URL → WebKit → Continue → verifyOtp → session in localStorage → reset form → password update → logout/login (disposable user). Founder link generated but not consumed.

reclassification_of_5j8b.reason: 5J8B Chromium E2E used a clean browser, a single fresh token_hash URL, and auto-verify on mount. Real founder Safari/Mail path failed verifyOtp (invalidated or already-consumed OTP) while UI only showed opaque 'No session found'.

verifyOtp.result: failure — no access_token returned to callback
verifyOtp.why_ui_said_no_session_found: obtainSupabaseAccessToken swallowed verifyOtp errors; getAuthCallbackErrorMessage only mapped URL hash errors from /auth/v1/verify, not verifyOtp API failures; existing same-user session path signed out and returned null

root_cause.class: one-time recovery OTP already invalid at real human verify + opaque error mapping; auto-verify on mount still unsafe against JS-executing previews
root_cause.exact: After 5J8B, email used app callback?token_hash&type=recovery. verifyOtp only runs in browser JS, but (1) mounting the callback auto-called verifyOtp so any JS preview/prerender could burn the OTP; (2) a second generateLink in the 5J8B send window invalidated the prior token; (3) verifyOtp otp_expired was swallowed and rendered as 'No session found', including when an existing Safari localStorage session was cleared. Storage handoff itself works when OTP is valid.
5j8b_test_discrepancy: clean context — no existing localStorage session
single fresh token — no double generateLink invalidation
HTTP prefetch without JS — does not exercise auto-verify burn
did not assert verifyOtp error-code UX (only URL hash otp_expired)
